What we do

From a weekly wash to long-term paint protection

Four levels of care, all carried out at your home or workplace.

  1. 01Valeting Mini, Full and Platinum valets for regular care or a full reset.
  2. 02Detailing Going beyond a valet to improve and protect the paint.
  3. 03Correction Machine polishing to reduce swirls, haze and light scratches.
  4. 04Protection Ceramic coating, with up to 24 months of protection.

01 · Valeting

Valet prices

Three valets, each building on the one before. Everything in the Mini is in the Full, and everything in the Full is in the Platinum.

Mini Valet

£40 About 2 hours

For new or well-kept cars that need a proper clean inside and out.

  • Citrus pre-wash, snow foam and hand wash
  • Wheels, door shuts and fuel cap cleaned
  • Tyres dressed
  • Hydrophobic rinse coating
  • Interior vacuumed, including mats and boot
  • Dashboard, steering wheel, plastics and glass cleaned
Book a Mini Valet What's in the Mini

Full Valet

£65 About 3 hours

For cars that have been let go for a while, or are going back at the end of a lease.

Everything in the Mini, plus:

  • Seats shampooed and extracted (leather cleaned)
  • Mats and carpets shampooed
  • Boot deep cleaned
  • Dashboard cleaned, including air vents
  • Foot pedals and indicator stalks cleaned
Book a Full Valet What's in the Full

Platinum Valet

£110 About 4–6 hours

For cars that need serious time spending on them to bring them back.

Everything in the Full, plus:

  • Leather seats deep cleaned and reconditioned
  • Roof lining cleaned
  • Wheel arches cleaned
  • Temporary paint protection applied
Book a Platinum Valet What's in the Platinum

Compare all three valets side by side

Which valet does your car need?

  • It's cleaned regularly and just needs freshening up.Mini Valet, £40
  • The seats or carpets are marked, the boot is grubby, or it's going back to the leasing company.Full Valet, £65
  • It needs everything: leather seats, the roof lining, the arches.Platinum Valet, £110

Not sure? Send two or three photos of the seats, carpets and outside, and we'll tell you which valet it needs before you book. Send photos on WhatsApp

Correction & protection

When the paint needs more than a wash

A valet gets the car clean. If the paint still looks dull or covered in fine swirls, or you want it protected for the long term, that's detailing.

03 · Correction

Machine polishing & paint correction

Polishing levels the clear coat so swirls, haze and light scratches stop catching the light. We check the paint first and tell you honestly what it can and can't fix.

Ford Fiesta bumper: before (left) and after (right).

About machine polishing

04 · Protection

Ceramic coating

A hard, water-repelling layer bonded to prepared paint. It keeps the car cleaner for longer, makes washing easier and gives up to 24 months of protection.

Ford Puma, ceramic coating package.

About ceramic coating

Common questions

Do you need water or electricity from me?

No. We can bring our own water and power, so we don't need anything from you. All we need is space to work around the car.

What happens if it rains?

Light rain doesn't stop us working. [CONFIRM WITH REBEL: what happens if the weather is too bad to work, e.g. how rebooking works.]

How long does a valet take?

About 2 hours for a Mini Valet, about 3 hours for a Full Valet and about 4–6 hours for a Platinum Valet, depending on the car's size and condition.

How do I pay?

We take card, cash or bank transfer.

Can you remove pet hair?

Yes. See the Ford Mondeo in our work, where heavy pet hair was removed from the carpets and seats. Heavy pet hair can cost extra, so send us a photo and we'll confirm the price before you book.

How do I book?

Use the quote form, message us on WhatsApp or call 07469 184950. Tell us the car, your postcode and what it needs, and we'll confirm the price and a time.
